name: Quiet frequency / a playable modular rack
art: The audio and scope are generated locally. Use original synthesis and scene code; do not import the reference's samples, private project state or brand identity.

properties.label: Editorial listening rack
properties.text: Pair an expressive editorial heading and explicit listening action with a broad scope and four carefully fitted modules. Make the waveform the largest evidence region; use knobs, an echo diagram and level strips for finer detail.

properties.label: Functional audio evidence modules
properties.text: Use waveform, filter, echo and output modules that share a visual language while each explains different information. Keep displayed metrics registered as signal data changes.

properties.label: Green-black rack with warm hardware
properties.text: Use deep green-black panels, warm silver and ivory, fine panel rims, restrained status lights, concentric dial markings and quiet mono labels.

properties.label: Opt-in Web Audio instrument
properties.text: Start listening creates a local Web Audio tone. Frequency, filter openness, echo and level change the sound, and the scope reads the analyser. Sound never starts on page appearance; controls remain keyboard operable.

properties.label: Audio and analyser lifecycle
properties.text: Stop, hidden-tab handling and unmount cleanup suspend or close audio. Reduced motion keeps useful controls without a travelling trace.

properties.label: Signal-linked audio verification
properties.text: Verify actual audio-node state, accurate controls, zero autoplay, bounded gain and cleanup. The scope must correspond to the signal rather than decorative random motion, and mobile must preserve the complete control set.
